cause: The temporary sparse integration checkout used directory junctions to shared source folders. Git sparse cleanup traversed those junctions and removed tracked source files. This was an agent setup error; no creative or save change was intended or authorized.
replacement_setup: All source/cache folder junctions removed; Git sparse checkout disabled into a complete ordinary private checkout; cache copied as ordinary files. Import and focused probes must pass anew.
acceptance: Aborted incomplete-fixture outputs do not count as runtime acceptance. Original machine failures and recovery evidence are preserved. Device, child, owner and authoritative visual gates remain separate.
save_scope: Only tracked assets/assets_src/gen2/export were restored from immutable Git blobs. Actual user-save directories were not read, rewritten or deleted. No full pre-incident ignored/untracked inventory is claimed.
